item.question: A crane of height 155 cm has its neck and the rest of its body in the ratio 4 : 6. For your height, if your neck and the rest of the body also had this ratio, how tall would your neck be?
steps_tex: Groups: $4 + 6 = 10$; the neck takes $4$ of every $10$ parts of the height.
For the crane: $4 \div 10 \times 155 = 62\text{ cm}$ of neck.
For your height, say $150\text{ cm}$: $4 \div 10 \times 150 = 60\text{ cm}$.
So your neck would be $\frac{4}{10}$ of your height.

item.question: In a Binairo row of 6 cells, the first two cells hold horizontal lines and the fifth holds a vertical line. Fill the row.
steps: Two horizontal lines are adjacent, so the third cell must be a vertical line.
A row of 6 cells needs 3 of each symbol; so far there are 2 horizontal and 2 vertical.
The fourth cell next to a vertical pair would make three verticals if cells 3, 4 and 5 were all vertical, so cell 4 is horizontal.
That makes 3 horizontal lines, so cell 6 is vertical: H H V H V V.
